LanguageData.OL_Preview_FromAllowed: From everything this policy allows, made new
LanguageData.OL_Preview_FromCraftable: From what the colony can make now
LanguageData.OL_Preview_MaterialTip: What the pieces are imagined in. A piece that can't be made of this material, that the policy doesn't allow in it, or that the colony can't afford in it (on the Craftable tab), uses the best material for this policy's priorities instead.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingAllowed: This policy allows nothing this colonist can wear.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingCraftable: The colony can't make anything this policy allows yet.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingToPick: Nothing in storage this policy allows.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_LayerEmptyTip: Nothing is worn on this layer. Click to see what could go here.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_LayerTip: Click to see everything that could go on this layer.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_LayerCoveredTip: {0} is worn on this layer too. Click to see everything that could go on it.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_ClearMarksTip: Clear the marks. Changes from here on are marked against the outfit as it is now.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_TriedOnTip: Trying it on. Click its row in the slot list again to stop.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_WhyTie: Ties on every stat, so it's the game's usual pick.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_WhyNoOrder: This policy has no priorities, so it's the game's usual pick.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_WhyGame: Left to the game's own rules.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_RunnerUpSmallerGain: Runner-up: {0}, with a smaller gain on {1}.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_RunnerUpSameLocked: Runner-up: {0}, the same locked item, worse on the priorities below it.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_RunnerUpLaterItem: Runner-up: {0}, a locked item lower in the priorities.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_RunnerUpScoredLower: Runner-up: {0}, which the game scored lower.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_ClickToOpen: Click to see what else could go here.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_Hint: Click a piece or a layer in the outfit to see what could go there.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_RankTip: The order the colonist would choose these in, 1 being their pick. Click to sort by it.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_SortHint: Click to sort by this column, highest first, then lowest first, then back to the colonist's choice. Right-click goes the other way.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_AddColumn: Add a stat as a column.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_AllowAllTip: Allow every item listed in this policy.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_ClearAllTip: Forbid every item listed in this policy. Locked items stay allowed.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_IsPick: The colonist's pick for this slot.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_PieceNotAllowed: This policy allows the item, but not this piece (its quality, condition or another filter).
LanguageData.OL_Slot_CantReach: The colonist can't reach it, or its outfit stand is switched off.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearLowScore: It scores too low for the game to put it on.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearBlocksVision: The game never puts on apparel that blocks vision by itself.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearSlaves: The game only puts slave apparel on slaves.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearMechanitors: The game only puts mechanitor apparel on mechanitors.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearModRule: The game or another mod rules it out for this colonist.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearCEShield: Combat Extended only lets a colonist use a shield with a one-handed weapon or none.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_LockWontWear: {0} Locking it won't change what {1} wears.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_Lock: Lock: pawns on this policy wear it over anything not locked, and it stays allowed. It's never swapped for a better piece that isn't locked, and nothing else you change in this window takes it off until it's unlocked. The game's own rules still apply.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_LockedInBase: Locked in {0}, the policy this one builds on. Unlock it there.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_LockedCheckbox: Locked, so it stays allowed. Unlock it to forbid it.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_ClickToTry: Click to try it on. The checkbox allows or forbids it in this policy.
